pages.quiz:
BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   C. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   C. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

5. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

7. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   D. Treat Insurance as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

10. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   B. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   C. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   C. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Networking in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

2. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

3. C — Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A — Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Explain symbols used on a map

7. A — Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. C — Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A — Nairobi

10. D — Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Plan income and spending wisely

12. A — Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Types of Business Ownership; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Networking in Business; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Entrepreneurship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Marketing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
